paragraphs: Rabbi Petoriki, Derosai’s brother, in Ivo’s and Rabbi’s names, Bamidbar Rabbah 12. The checked Midrash reads “Rabbi Ivo Abba.” In Abba bar Buna’s name, Chazit, “Its pillars he made silver”; Jerusalem Yoma, Taraf Bakkalpi.
